record.original_question: For the Directed Feedback Vertex Set problem, where the input is a directed graph G and a positive integer k and the task is to decide whether there exists a set S of k vertices such that every directed cycle of G contains a member of S, does the problem admit a polynomial kernel when parameterized by k?

evidence.quote: Question: Is there a set S of k vertices such that each directed cycle of G contains a member of S?
The existence of polynomial kernel is also open.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
The Directed Feedback Vertex Set problem (DFVS) is defined as follows. The input is a directed graph G = (V, E) and a positive integer k. A directed feedback vertex set of G is a subset S ⊆ V such that the induced subgraph G − S (obtained by deleting the vertices of S and all incident arcs) is acyclic; equivalently, every directed cycle of G contains at least one vertex of S. The decision question is whether G admits a directed feedback vertex set of size at most k.

A polynomial kernelization for a parameterized problem (in this case, DFVS parameterized by k) is a polynomial-time algorithm that, given an instance (G, k), outputs an equivalent instance (G', k') of the same problem such that |V(G')| + |E(G')| + k' ≤ p(k) for some polynomial p, and (G, k) is a yes-instance if and only if (G', k') is a yes-instance.

Question: Does Directed Feedback Vertex Set, parameterized by the solution size k, admit a polynomial kernel? That is, does there exist a polynomial-time preprocessing algorithm reducing every instance (G, k) to an equivalent instance whose total size is bounded by a polynomial in k?
artifact.status_search_result: The existence of a polynomial kernel for Directed Feedback Vertex Set parameterized by solution size k remains one of the most prominent open problems in kernelization. Recent papers (e.g., "Towards a Polynomial Kernel for Directed Feedback Vertex Set," 2020; "Wannabe Bounded Treewidth Graphs Admit a Polynomial Kernel for DFVS," 2025) explicitly describe it as open and obtain polynomial kernels only for restricted parameterizations or special graph classes.

status_evidence.title: Towards a Polynomial Kernel for Directed Feedback Vertex Set
status_evidence.snippet: The existence of a polynomial kernel for DFVS parameterized by solution size is described as a central open problem in kernelization.
status_evidence.claim: Problem remains open as of the publication; results provide only partial progress for restricted parameterizations.

status_evidence.title: Wannabe Bounded Treewidth Graphs Admit a Polynomial Kernel for Directed Feedback Vertex Set
status_evidence.snippet: Polynomial kernel obtained for a structural parameterization, while the main DFVS(k) kernelization question remains unresolved.
status_evidence.claim: Recent (2025) work still treats general DFVS polynomial kernel as open.
